Class GroveMotorDriverTb6612fng

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.device.motor.GroveMotorDriverTb6612fng
public final class GroveMotorDriverTb6612fng extends Object
Seeed Grove I2C Motor Driver (TB6612FNG): two brushed DC-motor channels, A and B, on one Grove I2C socket. The driver's own microcontroller turns each I2C command into the TB6612FNG's direction and PWM signals, so the board needs no motor pins. The motors need their own supply, 2.5 V to 13.5 V; the socket's 3.3 V or 5 V only powers the driver's logic.

Create one driver at startup over the board's bus, new GroveMotorDriverTb6612fng(MCU.getI2c()), and use getMotorA() and getMotorB() as DCMotors. Power is a percentage, scaled to the driver's 0..255 PWM. BaseMotor.stop() brakes a channel, and BaseMotor.flt() lets it coast. The driver answers at address 0x14 by default; pass the address it was given if it has been changed.

The constructor checks that the driver acknowledges on the bus, then takes it out of standby. Each later command is sent once, without a check, as with the other I2C devices, so a driver unplugged after startup stops the motors silently.
